_comment_top: Manifest for the AIY Plants V1 on-device classifier. The .tflite is the upstream INT8 / V1/3 variant extracted from the model.tar.gz bundle on Kaggle Models. Labels live alongside as labels.csv (the model's embedded probability-labels-en.txt, 2101 scientific names indexed 0..2100). AIY V1/3 is fully UINT8-quantized: BOTH input and output tensors are UINT8. Normalization is encoded in tensor quantization params (scale/zero_point), not applied externally — see PLANTPOTTING-0004 §1.1.
_comment_normalization_unused_for_uint8: AIY V1/3 is UINT8-quantized; the preprocessor feeds raw 0-255 bytes directly. The previously-declared normalization stanza (mean=127.5, std=127.5) was the FLOAT32 contract for an FP16 variant we do not ship. Removed in PLANTPOTTING-0004 to prevent silent contract drift; ImagePreprocessor branches on input_dtype.
_comment_thresholds: These mirror PLANTPOTTING-0003 §4.3 verbatim. They are the policy source-of-truth; the Kotlin ModelScoreMapper reads them at construction time, and ModelManifestTest sanity-checks they have not drifted.
_comment_coverage: Of the 18 plant_class_map.json mapping entries, only 2 (Monstera deliciosa, Crassula ovata) are present verbatim in the upstream 2101-label vocabulary. The remaining 14 species are not in the model's training set — they will route through LowConfidencePicker's manual search (PLANTPOTTING-0003 §4.3 unmapped path). This matches the §7.1 risk assessment; the design treats unmapped predictions as user-facing uncertainty rather than silent fallback.
